name: Adelinda
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 229 Adelinda: diameter 105.912 ± 1.779 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[mainbelt] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...791..121M)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 105.912 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Adelinda. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: J. Palisa found Adelinda at Vienna on 22 August 1882.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 105.912 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
